episodes.synopsis: A long time ago in the faraway land of ancient Greece, Demetrius pines after the lovely Apollonia. According to her father the mayor, she won`t give him the time of day until he learns to use his agility and athleticism to earn honor and glory, but all Demetrius wants to do is paint pottery.
episodes.title: You Are Hellenese

episodes.synopsis: Demetrius is invited to attend a modern day field day, where he witnesses sports being enjoyed in a way he previously thought impossible.
episodes.title: ZE.N.RA

episodes.synopsis: The mayor of the neighboring village threatens to go to war unless Apollonia marries his son. However, due to the three-month armistice mandated by the Olympics, an athletic competition is arranged instead.
episodes.title: A Man's Arete

episodes.synopsis: Inspired by the inventive and entertaining nature of Demetrius' egg race, the mayor asks him to come up with a hundred more events for Tortonia's local Olympics.
episodes.title: It Always Starts With Zeus

episodes.synopsis: Demetrius is tasked with coming up with unique games for the Tortonian Olympics, but his ancient Greek surroundings leave him uninspired. He experiences an epiphany at a swim meet in 20th Century Tokyo.
episodes.title: The Aegean Sea of Tears

episodes.synopsis: The mayor demands that Demetrius come up with prizes to offer at the Tortonian Olympics in order to increase participation. This time he finds inspiration at an elementary school field day.
episodes.title: Symposium Tonight

episodes.synopsis: Though Demetrius' prizes were well-received, they're not enough to encourage everyone to participate in the Tortonian Olympics. Those who lack physical prowess claim there's no reason for them to participate since they have no hope of winning any prizes.
episodes.title: Sweet Olympia

episodes.synopsis: With unique games and prizes, the Tortonian Olympics are coming together, but the village of Tortonia lacks skilled athletes. The mayor demands that Demetrius invent more games that the Tortonians are sure to win.
episodes.title: Endless Summer

episodes.synopsis: Summer, the season of war in ancient Greece, is approaching. Though the mayor and the other villagers seem excited, Demetrius is, as usual, less than enthusiastic.
episodes.title: Build a Tropaion

episodes.synopsis: A group of Spartans offer to help Tortonia with their Olympic games. Unfortunately, they've also offered wrestling lessons to the citizens of Tortonia.
episodes.title: Spartans Are Scary

episodes.synopsis: Much to everyone's dismay, the Spartans continue to educate Tortonians on the Spartan lifestyle.
episodes.title: Different Country, Different Face

episodes.synopsis: The Spartans have declared war against Tortonia! Somehow Demetrius and Apollonia are able to convince the Spartans to agree to an athletic competition instead, but how can Tortonia possibly win?
episodes.title: Goodbye Sparta

episodes.synopsis: At the party celebrating the departure of the Spartans, Demetrius gets a moment alone with Apollonia.
episodes.title: LADY discrimination

episodes.synopsis: The mayor suggests that Tortonia lies about being the originator of a cool and mainstream event in order to generate more interest in their upcoming Olympics.
episodes.title: What is Your Thlon

episodes.synopsis: The mayor is furious when he discovers that not even the nearby villages have heard about the Tortonian Olympics and demands that Demetrius fixes the problem.
episodes.title: Market of Dreams

episodes.synopsis: Word of the Tortonian Olympics has spread far and wide, but there's a new problem: it won't make any money.
episodes.title: Cheater

episodes.synopsis: When the mayor and Demetrius learn that the conditions at the Olympics are actually terrible, they see an opportunity to outdo their rival.
episodes.title: Your Pessoi

episodes.synopsis: The Olympics are better than the Tolympics in yet another way: food! With limited resources, how can Tortonia win this time?
episodes.title: The Philosopher's Dinner Table

episodes.synopsis: The mayor and Demetrius get to work coming up with a logo for the Tolympics in order to promote it effectively.
episodes.title: Herma! Herma! Herma!

episodes.synopsis: The Tolympics opening ceremony is beginning. While the mayor gives an excessively long speech, Demetrius and Apollonia get a moment alone together.
episodes.title: BURNING FIRE

episodes.synopsis: Enraged by Tortonia's impudence, Eleia threatens to go to war.
episodes.title: Villager A

episodes.synopsis: Demetrius fails to convince the mayor not to go to war. While lamenting the situation, he finds himself returning to Tokyopolis once again.
episodes.title: Your White Lie

episodes.synopsis: Demetrius returns to ancient Greece, but the armies have already reached the battlefield. Will he arrive in time to stop the war?
episodes.title: When We Say Goodbye...

episodes.synopsis: Demetrius makes one last desperate attempt to prevent a war from breaking out.
episodes.title: The Tolympics
